description.value: Crosstown Food Market is a neighbourhood convenience and food market on 196 Street in Surrey, BC. Tagged as air-conditioned, it offers a climate-controlled stop for cyclists traveling through the Cloverdale area. As a locally named food market rather than a chain store, it likely carries a broader range of everyday provisions than a typical convenience outlet.
